# Quick Canvas

> Quick Canvas is a simple paint app for Mac (macOS 13 or later), an independent alternative for people who miss Microsoft Paint. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time US$4.99 purchase. No subscription, no account, works offline.

Features: pencil, eraser and six brushes (round, calligraphy pen, marker, oil, crayon, spray); 17 shapes including curves, arrows and stars; rectangle and free-form selection with copy, paste and arrow-key nudging; crop, resize, rotate, flip; text; fill; colour picker; opacity; rulers and gridlines; zoom 25% to 800%; save as PNG, JPG, JPEG, PDF, GIF, TIFF, BMP and HEIC at high quality or smaller size; on-device Remove Background (macOS 14+); Apple Intelligence image creation (Apple silicon, macOS 15.2+). Saved files contain no watermark and no hidden metadata.
